subject: RE: Procurement & MAP: Redwood Inference evaluation (AcmeCloud)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Mar 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement next steps & MAP (Redwood x AcmeCloud)

Hi Samir —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Recap: AcmeCloud is evaluating Redwood for inference serving for your ML infra (low-latency endpoints + dedicated pools). We covered expected QPS, retention, and compliance needs.
- Commercial path/ask: can you confirm whether procurement will be PO (vendor onboarding) or do you prefer to charge to a corporate card? Also, is there any interest in procuring via the Cloud Marketplace to shortcut vendor onboarding?
- Security & legal: please confirm who will own the security questionnaire and the expected cadence for legal review. From similar deals, legal + security typically take 2–3 weeks combined but I want to align to your org.
- Finance: does your procurement team require a vendor form or Net terms to start the onboarding?

Attached is a draft mutual action plan (MAP v2) that breaks down milestones: legal review -> security questionnaire -> finance/vendor setup -> PO issuance. I can pull together a one-page SOW/quote if helpful.

Next actions: 
1) Samir to confirm commercial path (PO vs card) and marketplace interest (by EOD Fri)
2) Samir to share security contact and procurement/vendor onboarding owner
3) Redwood to send SOW + MAP v2 and pricing summary (by EOD Thu)

I’ve attached the MAP v2 for reference.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
[attachment: ACME-MAP-v2.xlsx]

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmecloud.com, Emily Zhao <emily.zhao@acmecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement next steps & MAP (Redwood x AcmeCloud)

Thanks Marissa — good call. Quick answers below and who owns what on our side: 

- Commercial path: Finance prefers a PO and vendor onboarding for anything >$50k. For smaller pilots we can use a corporate card, but likely this will be a PO.
- Marketplace: open to exploring the Cloud Marketplace, but that usually takes extra procurement steps on our side; for speed, PO/direct contract is preferred.
- Legal: I’ll kick off legal review next Monday (names: Anita Rao, legal@acmecloud.com). Expect 7–10 business days unless they have material redlines.
- Security: Emily Zhao (cc’d) will own the security questionnaire and left us a link to their standard questionnaire — I’ve included it here: https://acmecloud-secure.example.com/questionnaire/rdw.
- Finance/onboarding: procurement@acmecloud.com will handle vendor setup. They require a W-9 + vendor form + quote to start onboarding.

We’re targeting a PO issuance by mid-April if legal + security reviews proceed without blockers. I’ll confirm exact dates after legal kickoff.

Appreciate the MAP — please send the SOW and formal quote so procurement can attach to the vendor request.

Best,
Samir
VP, Partnerships | AcmeCloud
samir.patel@acmecloud.com
